typography.installation: import fonts via Google Fonts or Fontsource. Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is included (if not on Google Fonts, use 'Satoshi' or fallback to 'Space Grotesk' if needed, but Cabinet/Satoshi preferred).

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing for Home, Dense Grid for Admin

public_home.container: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-20 lg:py-32 flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[80vh]
public_home.search_bar: w-full max-w-2xl h-16 text-xl rounded-2xl shadow-sm border-2 border-zinc-200 focus-within:border-[#002FA7] transition-all bg-white

public_results.grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-8

admin_dashboard.surface_style: Grid Borders (Technical look) - use border-collapse style layouts with 1px solid borders.

ai_answer_card.style: bg-white border border-[#002FA7]/30 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden
ai_answer_card.decorator: Add a thin absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#002FA7] to-[#FF3366]

category_badge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border bg-zinc-50 border-zinc-200 text-zinc-800

button.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#00227A] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold transition-colors shadow-sm
button.secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors

input.default: bg-white border border-zinc-200 focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#002FA7] rounded-lg w-full transition-shadow

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a clean, sharp look to match the Swiss design aesthetic.

images.description: Subtle abstract gradient background for search home page
Abstract graphic for visual/image search fallback 1
Abstract graphic for visual/image search fallback 2

motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[2px] and shadow-md for interactive cards
motion.page_transition: Fade in with slight upward motion (framer-motion opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0)
motion.loading: Use an indeterminate linear progress bar spanning the top of the viewport or AI answer card in #002FA7, avoid generic spinners.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='submit-search-button', data-testid='favorite-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Shadcn UI components for the Admin panel (tables, cards, dialogs) but style them with strict, sharp borders (rounded-md instead of rounded-xl).
For the public UI, custom construct the layouts using Tailwind primitives rather than generic Shadcn cards to maintain the clean 'Perplexity/Google' feel.
Do not use transparent headers over content; always give the header a solid #FFFFFF or backdrop-blur bg-white/80 background.
Ensure the hero background image on the home page is applied via a pseudo-element or separate div with low opacity (e.g., opacity-40) so it does not distract from the search bar.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Configure Tailwind to use Cabinet Grotesk or Satoshi.
The AI Answer card must look distinct from standard search results. Use the provided styles.
